༄༅/ /'khor lo bde mchog bong zhal can gyi sgrub thabs man ngag gi rim pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'khor lo bde mchog bong zhal can gyi sgrub thabs man ngag gi rim pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo gar+dha bha mu kha he ru ka ya/ rdo rje mthon ka'i 'od zer gyis/ /bdud dpung lan brgyar bcom byas nas/ /sgrub la bde chen dngos grub stsol/ /rab 'jigs he ru ka la 'dud// 'dir mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub kyi khyad par rab 'byams zhig sgrub par 'dod pas/ sdom pa rtsa bshad kyi rgyud nas 'byung ba ltar rdo rje khrag 'thung bong bu'i zhal can sgom par bya'o/ /de la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yig brgya'i bsgom bzlas rnams sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ shrī he ru ko3haṃ/ rang skad cig gis bde mchog zhal gsum phyag drug par gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dza ཿ na mo gu ru bhe/ na ma ཿ shrī tsakra sam+bha ra maṇ+ḍa la bhe/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ byas dang byed du bcug dang yi rang ba'i/ /sdig pa ma lus skyon kun 'jigs byed pa'i/ /spyan mngar so sor bshags shing slar yang ni/ /mi byed pa yi sdom pa bla bar bgyi/ /nyan thos rang rgyal bla med rgyal ba dang*/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyi dge ba gang mdzad pa/ /de dag kun la yang dag yi rang zhing*/ /byang chub bar du yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /rgyal ba dkon mchog la sogs gsum po la/ / dngos po kun gyi bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de bzhin du/ /bla na med pa'i lam la brten par bgyi/ / tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par sgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung g-i dkyil 'khor sngon po zla zhing*/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du bam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/

de'i steng du sum̐ las ri rab rin po chen sna bzhi las/ grub pa/ de'i steng du pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla re/ mda'-i drwa ba/ phyi rol kun tu ye shes kyi me 'od 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo gyur/ oṃ me dhi ni badz+rī bha wa badz+ra ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pra ka ra hūm̐ pam̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pañtsa ra hūm̐ yam̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bi ra na hūm̐ kham̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dza la tram̐ tram̐ tram̐/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na larka hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la bh+rūm̐ las gzhal med khang*/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rtsigs pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ pha gu dang*/ bre phul dang*/ gser gyi snam bu dang*/ drwa phyed dang*/ shar bu dang / zla yab dang*/ bzungs ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i mdun du ka bas steg pa'i rta babs kyis mdzes pa/ nang gi lha snam/ shar dkar/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lha ser/ mtshams rnams su bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du/ sku'i 'khor lo dkar po/ rtsibs brgyad pa/ mu khyud la 'khor lo'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa/ de'i lte bar gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ mu khyud la pad+ma'i 'phreng bas mdzes pa/ de'i lte bar thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa mu khyud la rdo rje'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i lte bar bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa sdong bu cung zad dang bcas pa/ mu khyud la gri gug gi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ steng thog rim par phug pa'i dbus phyur bur gyur pa/ nang gi lha'i gnas rnams su nyi ma'i gdan sum cu rtsa gsum mo/ /gzhal med khang gi phyi rol mchod pa'i bkod pa thams cad dang bcas shing*/ pad 'dab kyi 'khor yug bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i phyi rol/

dur khrod chen po brgyad/ phyogs bskyong ba dang*/ zhing bskyod ba dang*/ shing dang*/ me dang*/ sprin dang*/ chu dang*/ ri dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi yongs su khyab pa'o/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ g.yon bskor gyi a ā zhes pa nas/ aṃ a ཿ zhes pa'i bar phrag gnyis/ zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du g.yas skor gyi ka kha nas/ ha k+ṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha/ phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de gnyis kyi bar du hūm̐ dkar po/ nam mkha'i na da hūm̐ yig de nyid la thim/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus/ de thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa yongs su gyur pa las/ lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs pa ni dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du 'khor lo bde mchog/sku mdog mthing nag drag po chen po nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal mthing ka bong bu'i gdong pa can khrag chen gyi byugs shing shin tu 'jigs pa/ g.yas zhal dkar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar ba/ lha zhal khro chags kyi nyams can/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan cing mche ba rtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyi mi lpags rlon pa rgyangs te 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na rtse gsum/ g.yon gsum pas thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas rkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ nor bu rin po chen dang*/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang mgo bo'i 'phreng ba can/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo/ / zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/

g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yas sdigs mdzug dang bcas pa'i rtse gsum 'phyar ba/ byin pa gnyis kyi yab la 'khril ba/ skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod skam gy-i do shal can/ khrag la dges shing khrag 'dzag pa/ gnyis ka 'ang bskal pa'i me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /'dab ma brgyad la shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ /de bzhi dang rdo rje phag mo ni bong bu'i zhal can/ zhal gyi gra nas mahā hu dhi ra'i rgyun 'bab pa'o/ /mtshams bzhir bum pa byang chub kyi sems kyi gang ba'i steng du kā pa la bdud rtsis gang ba dang bcas pa bzhi'o/ /'khor lo gsum gyi phyi rol/ dam tshig 'khor lo'i shar sgor kha gdong ma nag mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan pa g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba ma he'i gdong pa can pa/ lho nub tu gshin rje'i pho nya ma g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba ri dwags kri ṇa'i gdong pa can/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba stag gi gdong pa can/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang*/ g.yon sngo ba dom gyi gdong pa can/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas gnyis na rtse gsum dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing*/ skra grol/ rdo rje'i 'phreng bas dbu la brgyan cing mi mgo'i do shal can/ ro'i gdan la g.yas rkyang gi stabs kyi gnas pa dngos grub thams cad brtsol ba'o/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar phyogs su li ra ma la yar khaṇ+ḍa ka pa la/ byang phyogs dza lan+dha rar mahā kaṃ ka la/ nub phyogs o gri ya nar kaṃ ka la/ lho phyogs ar bu ta rar mche ba rnam par rtsigs pa/ shar lho gau dha ba rir lho'i sgra/ lho nub rasmi shwa rar 'od dpag med/

nub byang dwe ko ṭar rdo rje 'od/ byang shar ma la bar rdo rje'i sku ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po bya khyung gi gdong can/ phyag dang po gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar phyogs ka ma ru par aṃ gu ri/ byang phyogs oṃ ṭe ra rdo rje'i ral pa can/ nub phyogs ṭi ka sha ru ner dpa' bo chen po/ lho phyogs ko sa lar rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad/ shar lho ka liṅkar rab tu bzang ngo*/ /lho nub lam+ba kar rdo rje bzang po/ nub byang kañtsir 'jigs byed chen po/ byang shar hi ma lar mig mi bzang ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po rma bya'i gdong pa can/ phyag dang po gnyis kyi pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ sku'i 'khor lo'i shar phyogs pra ra pu rir stobs po che/ byang phyogs gri ha de bar rin chen rdo rje/ nub phyogs so sor ras ṭar rta mgrin/ lho phyogs su bar+ṇa dwi par nam mkha'i snying po/ shar lho na ga rar dpal he ru ka /lho nub sin+dhu pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug /nub byang ma rur rnam par snang mdzad/ byang shar ku lu tar rdo rje sems pa ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po seng ge'i gdong pa can/ phyag dang po gnyis kyi 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dpa' bo nyer bzhi po thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ 'og ma gnyis kyi rtsa gsum dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ nyi ma la g.yas rkyang gi stabs kyi bzhugs shing*/ rang snang gi shes rab ma dang bcas pa/ khyad par gzhan rnams bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa'o/ /gtso bo yab yum gyi thugs khar rang 'dra 'am phyag gnyis pa'i ye shes sems pa/ de'i thugs khar hūm̐ dang bam̐ ting nge 'dzin sems pa/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ yab rnams kyi thugs khar oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems pa/ mgon po ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu swā hā hu dmar po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug /mig gnyis su hūm̐ hūm̐ ho dmar ser rdo rje nyi ma/

tshigs chen brgyad la phaṭa haṃ ljang khu rta mchog gi ngo bo yab yum rnams kyi lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying khar haṃ yam̐ sngon po gshin rje ma khar hri mam̐ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyo da byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo/ rdo rje sems pa dang rmongs byed zla ba'i gdan dang*/ gzhan rnams nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa'o/ /rang gi thugs kha'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyi ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs/ phaiṃ/ dza ཿ hūm̐ baṃ ho ཿ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ slar yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ phaiṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yi/ /de bzhin bdag gi khru gsol lo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa yab yum la rnam snang*/ bde chen 'khor lo ba la rin 'byung*/ thugs 'khor ba la mi bskyod pa/ gsung 'khor ba la 'od dpag med/ sku 'khor ba la rnam snang / dam tshig 'khor lo ba la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ shrī tsakra sam+bha ra maṇ+ḍa la bhe/ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyi phyi mchod phul/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ skal ldan bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ skye dgu'i 'tsho ba bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ma hā bo dhi'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma bsam gtan 'od zer gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gu ge piṇ+ḍa ta'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog gi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po lha dbang grags pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lha thams cad kyi snying pos dkyil 'khor la phul/ a nu ra ga nas rjes chags kyi mchod pa yang phul la/ yab yum gyi rkang brgyad kyi bstod/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bde stong du 'char bar byas te mnyam par bzhag /rdzogs rim sgom par 'dod na skabs 'dir sgom/ 'khor lo'i bzlas pa'am spro bsdu'i bzlas pa gsal btab nas/ bzlas pa bya ste/ sngags 'phreng rgyas par ni/ lū yi pa dang mtshungs la/ bzlas pa'i snying po ni/ oṃ hrī ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'i yi ge bdun pa nyid la nan tan du 'bad par bya'o/ /bzlas pa'i gzhi ni/ lte bar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūm̐ dmar skya las/ dbugs phyi nang du 'gro ba dang brtun nas/ byed pa man ngag yin no/ /mthar bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pas byin gyis rlabs du gsol/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub 'khor lo bde mchog gi go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par mdzad du gsol/ sa bcu dag gi rim pa dang*/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sbyor ba yis/ /phyi dang nang gi chos rnams kun/ /byang chub phyogs kyi rnam par dag /dpa' bo'i rtsa ba'i sngags sogs gang*/ /tshangs pa'i kud pa la sogs rtag /lha'i snying po'i sngags kyi ni/ /'phreng ba brgya yi phyed kyi mdzes/ /yi ge bdun pa'i gsang sngags kyi/ /gdub 'khor gyis ni rna ba brgyan/ /rdo rje phag mo'i sngags gang yin/ /mgrin pa mgur chus mdzes pa nyid/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro'i sngags/ /lpags pa'i gos mchog 'dzin pa'o/ /rnal 'byor ma grub gsang sngags kyi/ /ske rags byas pas brgyan pa yin/ /dpa' bo'i go cha drug po ni/ / phyag rgya yis ni lus mdzes pa'o/ /'khor lo kun gyi rnal 'byor ma'i/ /sngags ni btung ba'i thod pa'o/

/rnam snang mdzad ces sngags gang yin/ /thod pas dbu la brgyan pa'o/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi yis/ /lus kyi khams ni rnam par dag kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni lha yi sku/ /shes rab ḍā ma ru yi sgra/ /nyin mo bcom ldan dpa' bo ste/ /rnal 'byor mo ni mtshan mor brjod/ /mya ngan las byung dpa' bo ni/ /drug pa sems kyi sprul pa yin/ /dag po chos kyi sprul pa ni/ /phag mo'i gzugs su bstan pa'o/ /shrī yig gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o/ / zhes dag pa dran par byas la/ rang gi snying kha'i 'od zer gyi snang ba thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor gyur/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim/ dkyil 'khor yang rim gyis 'od gsal gyi dbyings su thim/ slar yang phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal du langs te/ go cha gnyis kyi rgyas btab la mthun mtshams la 'jug go /gtor ma'i cho ga ni/ lwa ba bcu gsum ma dang 'dra ba yin pas/ de'i sgrub thabs dang sdom 'byung bcu gsum ma'i sgrubs thabs su shes par bya'o/ /gang zhig sgom par byed pa la/ /phun tshogs bye ba mtha' yas pa/ /'byung 'gyur de yi pha mtha' ni/ /bye ba'i gdong gis brjod nus sam/

/'khor lo bde mchog bong zhal can gyi sgrub thabs man ngag gi rim pa zhes bya ba rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo sum cu pa la gser mdog can gyi chos grwar sbyar ba'o/ / dge legs 'phel// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/'khor lo bde mchog bong zhal can gyi sgrub thabs man ngag gi rim pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 368 -- PAGE 367 -- PAGE 365 -
